text.Manifesto Trustio | Segurança, liberdade: Trustio Manifesto | Security, freedom and purpose
text.O Manifesto Trustio defende uma inteligê: The Trustio Manifesto stands for artificial intelligence that is transparent, auditable, secure and built to serve the business.
text.A inteligência artificial deve ser usada: Artificial intelligence should be used with security, freedom and purpose.
text.A confiança é a infraestrutura que trans: Trust is the infrastructure that turns artificial intelligence into strategic capability.
text.Acreditamos que a inteligência artificia: We believe artificial intelligence will be the most important infrastructure of this generation.
text.Mas nenhuma empresa deveria abrir mão do: But no company should have to give up control of its data to be part of that future.
text.Ela deve ser construída para servir ao n: It should be built to serve the business, not to lock it in.
text.Capítulo 2, o futuro que defendemos: Chapter 2, the future we stand for
text.Defendemos um futuro em que organizações: We stand for a future in which organizations can choose the best models, deploy quickly and evolve their architecture freely.
text.Tecnologia de ponta só gera valor quando: Cutting-edge technology only creates value when there is trust.
text.Confiança para inovar, integrar e cresce: Trust to innovate, integrate and grow.
text.Para inovar sem comprometer dados, segur: To innovate without compromising data, security or governance.
text.Para escolher modelos, arquiteturas e ca: To choose models, architectures and paths without forced lock-in.
text.Para transformar tecnologia em resultado: To turn technology into real results for the business and for people.
text.Nossa missão é transformar a inteligênci: Our mission is to turn artificial intelligence into strategic capability for businesses.
text.Fazemos isso com infraestrutura confiáve: We do it with reliable infrastructure, open architecture and results-driven deployment.
text.Não vendemos apenas modelos. Construímos: We don't just sell models. We build the foundation on which companies will create their next generation of products, services and decisions.
text.CONSTRUÍDO NO BRASIL • HOSPEDADO NO BRAS: BUILT IN BRAZIL • HOSTED IN BRAZIL •
text.A Trustio nasce para oferecer às organiz: Trustio exists to give organizations more control over where their data is processed and how their artificial intelligence is run.
text.Porque a verdadeira vantagem competitiva: Because the real competitive advantage isn't just having an artificial intelligence model.
